  "rationale": "Approval must precede billing. Conflicting status reports and unclear ownership at the approval handoff leave actors unsure who should act or whether a retry would duplicate an effect. The fixture establishes only the blocked state. The redesign assigns authority for each fact, keeps the sender accountable until handoff acceptance, and requires billing reconciliation before replay. Its verification scenarios cover completion, interruption, cancellation, accessible recovery, and unrelated records. Policy details and billing guarantees remain explicit implementation questions. The execution events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match."
